technique_name: Using the input provided, write a story about a student who graduates from a university and returns home.
description:
Jayden had dreamed of attending college since she was a small child, and she was thrilled when she was accepted to the University of California, San Diego. After four long years of hard work in her engineering program, Jayden was proud to graduate and had big dreams of carving out a successful career. 

However, Jayden was a bit apprehensive about returning home; she had worked so hard to become her own person, and now she wasn't sure how her family and friends would accept her new identity. But
